title: Capability: use_item spends the printed activation turn resource
description: Selected under the user's 2026-10-12 rule (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent): this structure stays TYPED in the SRD pack because a positive engine capability is more likely than not in the near future, so the capability must exist before the re-freeze (eshyra-o9bd.14). Capability contract per ADR 0020 / eshyra-olc5: operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real binding to the pack fields, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed for unsupported input. Pack shape is owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6 (PR #656); coordinate field shapes with it rather than changing the pack later. Scope: when an item operation's typed activation cost is action, bonus-action or reaction, use_item (and the turn loop) spend that turn resource through the existing turn-resource tracking (spend_turn_resource / begin_turn) in combat, refusing when it is unavailable; operations with no typed cost (DM-adjudicated) spend nothing automatically. Include spell-normal-casting-time handling for spells cast from items.
